cases.question: ¿Cuántas sesiones cerradas tuvo cada caja durante octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(*) AS sesiones FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(cs.id) AS sesiones_cerradas FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se registró en ventas en efectivo y otros medios, desglosado por caja, en las sesiones cerradas durante octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue la suma de las diferencias de cierre de las sesiones cerradas en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cs.difference), 0) AS diferencia FROM cash_session cs WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cs.difference), 0) AS suma_diferencias FROM public.cash_session AS cs WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-10-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-11-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto dinero se movió por tipo de movimiento de caja en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cm.type, SUM(cm.amount) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY cm.type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cm.type AS tipo_movimiento, SUM(cm.amount) AS total_movido FROM public.cash_movement AS cm JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cm.session_id = cs.id WHERE cs.opened_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND cs.opened_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cm.type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el importe de los egresos manuales de caja, desglosado por caja registradora, en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cm.amount) AS egresos FROM cash_movement cm JOIN cash_session cs ON cs.id = cm.session_id JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY egresos DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total_egresos FROM public.cash_movement AS cm JOIN public.cash_session AS cs ON cm.session_id = cs.id JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cm.type = 'EXPENSE' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50
